$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). Error code names are final only after review with the BE-10 (#33) owner.
title: VoiceActionResponse
description: Response body for POST /v1/voice/actions. Either the action was accepted and executed, or it was denied with a typed error. The message is always present and safe to speak or show in the overlay.

result.description: Outcome. Clients map values they do not know to UNKNOWN and must not treat UNKNOWN as success.

action.description: The action name as received. Accepted results carry an allowlisted action; denied results echo the requested name so the overlay can name it.

target.description: Echo of the request target. Required when accepted; present on denial whenever the request carried a well-formed target.

message.description: Short English sentence for the overlay or spoken reply, for example 'Opened the check.' Never contains a transcript or another user's identifier.

error.description: Shared error shape (BE-05) restricted to the voice-action codes. Present only when result is denied; its request_id echoes the response request_id.
